d:
Vaibhav Sisinty, Founder of GrowthSchool, talks about AI, content creation, and the skills needed to work effectively in an AI-first world.
He explains:
• How he 10x'd company revenue in 2.5 years by rebuilding his entire workflow around AI
• Why overusing AI tools made his team progressively worse at their own jobs
• How to use AI tools effectively without losing your team
• Why all major AI models think alike and what his Anthropic experiment revealed about it
• How he built a personal AI memory trained on his entire content history to preserve his own voice
